task.title: Regenerating a robot account token by using the Red Hat Quay UI
task.shortdesc: To replace a robot account credential from the Red Hat Quay UI, you can regenerate the robot account token for an organization robot account.

ul.li: You have logged into Red Hat Quay.

step.cmd: Click the name of an organization.
In the navigation pane, click Robot accounts.
Click the name of your robot account, for example, testorg3+test.
Click Regenerate token in the popup box.
